entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, do ya think nurses ever... y'know...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm? I'm afraid I don't.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Come on, like you go in for a "physical[n]exam" and the nurse just... argh!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Doc! Give us the lowdown! Does that[n]kinda thing really happen!?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: What? Erm, there isn't really much to[n]say...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So you don't deny it! It totally happens[n]all the time, doesn't it!?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: No! Of course not! Wait, Sakamoto-kun,[n]are you getting a nosebleed?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Get this boy to the clinic, stat!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This is chaos...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I gotta say, Dr. Maruki... Your social[n]skills are god-tier.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Haha... Thank you, but I have a long[n]way to go.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I still get rather nervous when I meet[n]someone for the first time.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wow, really? I didn't get that vibe from[n]you at all.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: That may be due to our relationship as[n]counselor and student.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: As part of my job, I naturally put on a[n]certain façade. It makes the words flow[n]more easily.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: So you're saying... fake it till you make it?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Wait a minute. All I need to do to get[n]good at socializing is learn how to act[n]like someone I'm not?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: All right, it's theater time! For my first role,[n]I'll be a beautiful blonde bombshell!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ooh, that sounds like fun! Okay, I'll play[n]the role of a world-renowned Hollywood[n]actress!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What are you gonna be, Dr. Maruki!?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: M-Me!? Uhh, hmm...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: The other day, I saved a cat from a tall[n]tree. I hadn't climbed like that in quite a[n]while.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: You did? That's so sweet, Dr. Maruki!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: The thing is, even though I was trying[n]to help, the cat lashed out at me with[n]its claws...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: And then I fell right out of the tree. It[n]was a bit of a disaster.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: O-Oh... That does sound rough...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You're so naïve. Trying to be a good[n]person only gets you taken advantage of.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You'd be a perfect target for scammers.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Ahaha, not to worry. It's not as though[n]I go out lending money to— Oh.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Did... Did you get scammed?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: No, no, nothing like that. It's just that I[n]met this elderly man at the train station[n]who told me he'd forgotten his wallet.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: He needed money to get back home,[n]so I agreed to lend him some...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Unfortunately, he never contacted me[n]again.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: That... definitely sounds like a scam.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Hah! What an absolute fool.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Niijima-san! I heard you're skilled at[n]aikido.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Huh? Well, I do have some experience...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Would you mind teaching me one day?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I've always been interested in it. Hi-yah![n]Wha-taaah! See?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Um, you don't actually need to make[n]sounds like that...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh! If you're teaching, then allow me[n]to learn as well!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I've always admired your grace when I[n]see you do martial arts, Mako-chan.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Then let's both become her apprentices![n]We look forward to your teachings,[n]Master!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm honored to be your protégé!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sorry, this is a bit much for me...
